name: ReSono-Labs-R1-Voice
description: JackRabbit is a standalone, non-commercial community voice system for the Rabbit R1 that combines a native HOME application, OpenAI Realtime voice, an on-device runtime, local storage, and a browser-based management interface while preserving the working Rabbit/Cipher hardware foundation. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
